field_disposition.shadow_eligible_text_only: No detected field issues; text support remains separate from PDF fidelity and production action-readiness.
field_disposition.review: One or more deterministic issues; retain both hard and soft lists.

semantic_resolution: Only a completed, valid four-dimension verifier result with supported / matched / preserved / absent can resolve soft issues. Hard issues continue to block shadow field acceptance. Runtime owns this gate; proposer does not call models.
email_multiplicity: Several extracted email strings are competing role candidates, not proven conflicts. A runtime may clear multiplicity for a unique matched submission candidate only if every other email candidate is positively mismatched for this role; any insufficient/failed/unclassified competitor keeps review. Several matched submission emails stay review pending explicit multi-destination policy.
date_multiplicity: Distinct absolute close-date proposals for one document remain hard scope-unresolved. No first/last-date choice.
notice_completeness: Missing one field, wrapped-token suspicion or participation evidence without a supported absolute date requests parser fallback/source review but does not itself invalidate an independently supported other field. The document still requires source audit.
fallback: No hidden fallback reads. Acquired fallback is a separate manifest/channel/invocation, with identity and retained-byte checks.
source_fidelity: No text-only decision establishes original-PDF fidelity. All accepted outputs are shadow fields with no production authorization.
